what: The gRNA modality is named `guide`

name: invalid/screens/bad_modality_name.h5mu
what: A modality named `1rna`

name: invalid/screens/cells_in_another_order.h5mu
what: The gRNA modality lists two cells in the other order

name: invalid/screens/compressed_by_cell.h5mu
what: The RNA counts are marked as compressed by cell (`csr_matrix`), as in an IGVF file

name: invalid/screens/pointers_past_the_end.h5mu
what: The last column pointer is larger than the number of stored values

name: invalid/screens/cells_unsorted_within_a_feature.h5mu
what: Two cell positions of the first gene are swapped

name: invalid/screens/stored_zero.h5mu
what: A zero is stored as if it were a count

name: invalid/screens/counts_as_doubles.h5mu
what: Counts stored as doubles, as R's MuData writes them by default

name: invalid/screens/counts_as_uint16.h5mu
what: Counts stored as 16-bit unsigned integers, as an IGVF file has them

name: invalid/screens/cell_positions_64_bit.h5mu
what: Cell positions stored as 64-bit integers beside 32-bit column pointers

what: Column pointers stored as 64-bit integers beside 32-bit cell positions: mixed widths, which scipy rejects in some operations

what: Both index arrays stored as 64-bit integers in a file small enough for 32-bit. The same file is what a file past the limit must look like: with the limit lowered for the test, the validators pass it

name: invalid/screens/shared_column_named_like_a_modality.h5mu
what: A shared cell column named `rna_quality`

name: invalid/screens/n_umis_as_labels.h5mu

name: invalid/screens/boolean_column.h5mu
what: A true/false cell column stored as booleans, as Python writes it by default

name: invalid/screens/integer_column_64_bit.h5mu
what: A 64-bit integer cell column, as pandas writes integers by default

name: invalid/screens/text_covariate.h5mu
what: A cell covariate stored as plain text instead of a categorical

name: invalid/screens/nullable_string_column.h5mu
what: A gRNA column in anndata's nullable string encoding, which R cannot open

name: invalid/screens/categorical_code_out_of_range.h5mu
what: A categorical with a code beyond its categories

name: invalid/screens/integer_column_with_missing_value.h5mu
what: An integer cell column holding R's missing-integer value

name: invalid/screens/no_grna_target.h5mu
what: The gRNA table has no `grna_target`

what: The gRNA table stores `grna_group`, which depends on the analysis

what: Two gRNAs with different targets share a `vector_id`: a combinatorial screen

what: A vector is named with the identifier of a gRNA on another vector

name: invalid/screens/vector_id_as_a_number.h5mu
what: `vector_id` stored as numbers

name: invalid/screens/target_start_zero.h5mu
what: A target starts at position 0: a 0-based coordinate, as in a BED file

name: invalid/screens/target_end_before_start.h5mu
what: A target ends before it starts

name: invalid/screens/target_start_without_chromosome.h5mu
what: A gRNA has a target start and end and no chromosome

name: invalid/screens/positions_without_genome_build.h5mu
what: The gRNA table has positions and the file has no `genome_build`

name: invalid/screens/target_start_as_text.h5mu
what: `target_start` stored as text

name: invalid/screens/duplicate_cell_identifiers.h5mu
what: Two cells have the same identifier

name: invalid/screens/gene_named_like_a_grna.h5mu
what: A gene and a gRNA have the same identifier

name: invalid/screens/identifier_with_a_line_feed.h5mu
what: A cell identifier contains a line feed

name: invalid/screens/no_format_entries.h5mu
what: The file has neither `perturb_seq_format` nor `dataset_id`

name: invalid/screens/title_as_a_number.h5mu
what: The optional title is a number

name: invalid/screens/unknown_perturbation_type.h5mu
what: The optional perturbation type is not one of the listed kinds

name: invalid/screens/format_from_the_future.h5mu
what: The data file's format version is 9.0

name: invalid/screens/format_as_a_number.h5mu
what: The data file's format is the integer 0, not a version

name: invalid/analyses/no_analysis_json
what: `analysis.json` is missing

name: invalid/analyses/no_response_modality
what: `analysis.json` does not name a response modality

name: invalid/analyses/response_modality_grna
what: `analysis.json` names `grna` as the response modality

name: invalid/analyses/response_modality_not_in_file
what: The response modality is `protein`, which the data file does not have

name: invalid/analyses/analysis_format_from_the_future
what: The analysis's format version is 9.0

name: invalid/analyses/absolute_path_to_the_data
what: The hint to the data file is an absolute local path

name: invalid/analyses/another_dataset
what: The dataset identifier is that of another data file; the parts of the fit cache are then another dataset's, which is allowed and unused

name: invalid/analyses/record_of_another_stage
what: The record in `discovery/` says it is the record of the power stage

name: invalid/analyses/side_up
what: The parameters record has `side` set to `up`

name: invalid/analyses/moi_medium
what: The parameters record has `moi` set to `medium`

name: invalid/analyses/no_seed
what: The parameters record has no `seed`

name: invalid/analyses/stage_without_its_predecessor
what: The assignment record is missing while later stages remain

name: invalid/analyses/listed_file_missing
what: A table that a record lists is not in the folder

name: invalid/analyses/table_truncated
what: `cells.parquet` has fewer rows than its stage wrote

name: invalid/analyses/table_listed_outside_the_stage_folder
what: A record lists a table by a path that leaves the stage's folder

name: invalid/analyses/required_table_not_listed
what: The QC record does not list `cells.parquet`, which is still in the folder

name: invalid/analyses/stale_results
what: The discovery record is gone and its results table remains

what: `cells.parquet` has no `in_use` column

name: invalid/analyses/column_of_the_wrong_type
what: `pass_qc` is stored as integers

name: invalid/analyses/rows_not_sorted
what: The assignment table is in reverse order

what: The assignment table has the same (gRNA, cell) twice

what: The assignment table names a cell the data file does not have

name: invalid/analyses/grna_column_under_the_union_strategy
what: A pair-QC table has a `grna_id` column in an analysis that pools gRNAs by target

name: invalid/analyses/grna_column_in_bonferroni_discovery
what: The discovery results of a bonferroni analysis have a `grna_id` column

name: invalid/analyses/significant_stored
what: The discovery results store a `significant` column

name: invalid/analyses/no_log_2_fold_change
what: The discovery results have no `log_2_fold_change` (T5.1)

name: invalid/analyses/effect_sizes_disagree
what: A `log_2_fold_change` is not the base-2 logarithm of the row's `fold_change`

name: invalid/analyses/fit_part_without_identity
what: A part of the fit cache does not say how its fits were made, as after a tool rewrote it; a reader takes no fit from it

name: invalid/analyses/fit_identity_incomplete

name: invalid/analyses/fit_identity_not_json
what: The identity inside a part of the fit cache is not JSON

name: invalid/analyses/identity_file_in_the_fit_cache

name: invalid/analyses/fits_before_qc
what: An analysis that stopped after assignment holds a fit cache

name: invalid/analyses/fit_with_too_few_coefficients
what: A saved fit has fewer coefficients than the design has terms

name: invalid/analyses/formula_with_an_interaction
what: The formula has an interaction, outside the additive subset; the fit cache was made for another formula, which is allowed and unused
